entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Projection of constant owned entity with implicit conversion throws #38410

Closed

  • EF10 generated SQL query for ExecuteDeleteAsync when using Take not optimal #38324
  • EF Core 11.0: Complex types and JSON Columns on Entity Types with TPT creates Duplicate JSON Column in Child Table #37937
    11.0.0
  • EFCore 8: DbContext saves detached entities #33557
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Run Cosmos tests against the Linux emulator (`vnext-latest`) #38413
  • Route many-to-many loading through an injectable IManyToManyLoaderFactory (#38363) #38411
    community-contribution
  • Use ConstructorExpression in CSharpRuntimeAnnotationCodeGenerator #38409
  • Move IOperationReporter, ISnapshotModelProcessor and SnapshotModelProcessor to EFCore.Relational #38408

Merged

  • [release/11.0-preview5] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38412
  • Fix duplicate JSON column in TPT child tables for complex types declared on base entity type #37958
    api-review
  • Hold detached entries weakly in the change tracker #38387
    community-contribution
  • Replace XUnitV3Project with MTPProject in helix.proj #38397

Updated

  • Fix unnecessary joins in consecutive Select projections with conditionals #37601
  • Fix ExecuteUpdate returning -1 on open connections by setting NOCOUNT OFF #37827
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Guard EF file generation during commandline builds to fix AOT build fork bomb #38403
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/10.0] Fix 'ordinal -1 is invalid' crash when a nested JSON complex sub-collection grows #38373
    Servicing-consider
  • Switch Microsoft.Data.Sqlite to SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle #38402
  • Cosmos: single-property projection no longer implicitly filters undefined #38405
